milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting purple_dye (from blue_dye + red_dye) results in purple_dye appearing in the player's inventory. Purple dye is not provided in the starting chest or player inventory, so its presence confirms the player successfully crafted it. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting magenta_wool (from magenta_dye + white_wool) results in magenta_wool appearing in the player's inventory. Magenta wool is not provided in the starting chest or player inventory, and can only be obtained by completing the full crafting chain: purple_dye + pink_dye → magenta_dye, then magenta_dye + white_wool → magenta_wool. Its presence in inventory is definitive proof of task completion. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
